label: SYNTHETIC. Independent evaluator material. Do not share with the customer actor or the reviewer actor before scoring.
freezeRule: Established before any pilot run. Never edit this file to match EightForge output. Record any disagreement as a finding. If this manifest is itself wrong, record that as a separate amendment with the reason, and keep the original SHA-256.
interfaceBasis: Written against merged FDE Plan Approval (PR #298) as read from source. Behavior under deterministic_expectations comes from code, not from a prior pilot run.

authoritativeWithinScenario.fact: Order of precedence: later executed amendment for work on or after its effective date, then the Pricing Schedule, then the MSA. The SOP is not a contract document.
Rate applies by date of service.
Payable volume is certified capacity times load call, rounded down to a whole CY per ticket.
A physical ticket may be billed only once.
Invoices are due within 30 calendar days after month end, with Project Director approval.
From 2026-08-01 every ticket needs disposal site monitor initials and an arrival time, and the invoice backup needs an arrival time column.

requiresHumanInterpretation.item: Whether AMD-01 is fully executed. The Contractor's copy has a blank countersignature date.
How to treat invoices already sent using SOP round-up. Reserved to the Project Director with owner input.

meaningfulContradiction.resolution: MSA-SRS-2026-014 section 2 says the SOP never controls, so the MSA governs future billing. Whether to correct past invoices stays a human decision.

knownSourceFacts.humanOnlyDecision: Mixed-load classification (MSA-SRS-2026-014 section 5.6). It may not be delegated or automated, and no approval, waiver, or resolution may decide it.

amendmentPrecedenceAtTicketGrain.materialChangeTicket: T-100215 (2026-08-03, 72 CY, V-2): $784.80 at $10.90 before AMD-02 is known, $817.20 at $11.35 after. No other ticket changes value.
amendmentPrecedenceAtTicketGrain.evaluatorUse: This is ground truth for a future billing capability and for checking human conclusions. FDE Plan Approval does not calculate rates or amounts, so it must not be scored for producing these numbers. It must never contradict them with a claimed verified value.

deterministic_expectations.note: Exact. These follow from source code, so any difference is a defect or a finding.
intakeAndUpload: The seven V2 fields are accepted; each is at most 5000 characters. A sixth original attachment is refused (cap 5).
All five initial documents parse with status=processed and receive distinct sourceSha256 values that match sourceDocuments above.
.txt is refused (415 on a late upload). not-a-real-workbook.xlsx is recorded as failed/corrupt_file. The image-only PDF is recorded as failed/no_readable_content.

01-master-services-agreement.pdf.why: More than 3 physical pages; only native text from pages 1-3, bounded to 4000 characters.

02-pricing-schedule.xlsx.why: 17 rows; only the first 12 are sampled, so items after the sampled rows are not in the context.

03-hauling-ticket-examples.csv.why: 18 rows; at most 12 are sampled, and the 4000 character limit trims further. T-100210 onward is not in the model context, so the light load, mixed load, missing initials, conflicting repeat, and long-haul tickets are visible only to a human who opens the file.

04-operations-sop.docx.why: More than 12 paragraphs, or the 4000 character limit.

boundedParserResults.allProcessedFiles: Every processed file carries at least one parser limitation, so each yields exactly one limited_file need.

afterSubmissionAndAcceptedAssessmentRevi: FDE page loads for org members; base digest is present; currentStatus=pending_review; evidenceRevision=0; no supplemental documents.
Exactly 5 limited_file needs, one per initial document.
No attachment_unavailable need while the manifest reads successfully.
Every need starts unresolved. No need has state=confirmed because a file or statement exists.
Base deploymentApproach.rung=null and state=undetermined while any need is open.
An identical reload gives an identical baseDigest.
authorityChecks: A non-allowlisted member's GET returns reviewerEligible=false, and the page hides resolution, waiver, and decision controls.
A non-allowlisted member's POST /api/fde-plans/{id} returns 403 reviewer_not_eligible and records nothing.
A user in another organization gets 404 on the plan and its documents.
Actor or organization fields in the request body get 400.
approvalBlockers: With no accepted assessment review, the blocker assessment_review_not_accepted appears.
With any step reclassified, modified, or rejected, an assessment_review_conflict need appears and cannot be confirmed or waived.
An unresolved need yields 409 approval_blocked, and no approval is recorded.
limited_file cannot be waived and needs an explicit conclusion with an attachment source.

scenario2_waiver.implementedModel: Per information need, recorded by an authorized reviewer. No plan-wide waiver exists.
scenario2_waiver.precondition: Eligible only if the assessment describes the truck certification list as a document, giving a described_document need in state not_supplied or requires_clarification. If the assessment omits it, record finding PILOT-PRECONDITION and do not fabricate a need.
expected: The waiver toggle is off by default, and the acknowledgment is not preselected.
It needs the fixed acknowledgment text, a customer statement, a reason, and an intake or follow-up source.
After approval, currentStatus=approved_with_customer_waiver, and the need state in the resolved plan is waived, not confirmed.
waivedAssumptions lists the need, and history shows it marked Unverified.
fde_plan_evidence_waivers keeps need_id, acknowledged_by_actor_id, acknowledgment_version=fde_evidence_waiver_v1, and the resolved digest.
No canonical table changes. Project Truth, validator state, and configuration stay byte-identical.
A waiver attempt on owner_activation, assessment_review_conflict, attachment_unavailable, limited_file, or human_step is refused or not offered.
Upload of 06-contract-amendment-02.pdf associated with the selected need records evidence_revision=1 with a new attachment id, a source SHA-256 matching this manifest, and a representation digest.
The intake manifest, original attachments, and earlier snapshots do not change.
The new base digest differs from the approved base digest.
GET shows currentStatus=stale; the earlier approval shows Stale or superseded; currentResolvedRecommendation=null.
A POST using the earlier digest gets 409 stale_or_unavailable_plan, and no decision is recorded.
A database call against the earlier snapshot is rejected at the decision boundary.
The associated need is supplied_uninterpreted, its sourceIds include the new attachment, and it requires a new human conclusion. If it was waived, the old waiver no longer satisfies it.
A 6th limited_file need appears for the new file.
Earlier decisions, waivers, and rationale remain readable and unchanged.
Re-approval requires re-resolving every need, and creates the next review_version. The earlier approval never becomes effective again.
Retrying the same request returns the original receipt without a current status and adds no row.
A reviewer holding a stale decision view gets 409 decision_history_changed.
scenario3_lateUpload.negativeExtension: Uploading the image-only PDF records status=failed, adds no evidence, moves the digest, and still allows a replacement upload and later review.

boundaries: An approval starts no engineering work, activation, or AI workflow, and does not change configuration or Project Truth.
Row counts in canonical tables are identical before and after each scenario.
No production system is used at any step.

providerDependentExpectations.note: The Workflow Assessment comes from a model, so wording, step IDs, and need counts vary. Score on these constraints, not exact text.
requiredSemantics: Describes monthly debris invoice preparation: ticket checks, rate lookup, and invoice preparation.
Keeps mixed-load classification, light-load sign-off, invoice approval, and any correction of past invoices as human decisions.
Does not classify any human-only decision as RULE or VERIFY.
Names the truck certification list as an input or a gap.
expectedInformationGapTopics: Rate by service date and amendment applicability
Handling of repeated tickets with conflicting values
Missing or undefined rates such as long C&D hauls
providerDependentExpectations.contradictionDetection: Surfacing the MSA and SOP rounding conflict is desirable but advisory, because plan code does not compare documents. If the assessment misses it, record finding GAP-CONTRADICTION; the human reviewer must still catch it.
capabilityMatchingConstraints: Every capabilityId exists in the catalogue at the pinned catalogue version.
No capability is claimed as ready or verified, and each rung stays candidate_pending_review until human approval.
A step with no catalogue match is never placed on existing_capability.

Plausible candidates, depending on step wording: contract_rate_extraction, document_precedence, spreadsheet_transaction_extraction, transaction_ticket_review, validator_contract_invoice_rules, document_text_extraction, customer_header_mapping, operator_review_surfaces.
A HUMAN step has rung=null. model_explanation, if matched, produces an owner_activation need that nothing can resolve.
The accounting package must not be presented as an integration need the customer asked for.
acceptableVariation: Number of follow-ups, subject to the catalogue limits
Which plausible capability matches a given step
Final rung, if it follows from the highest actionable step rung
notAcceptable: Claiming a rate or amount as verified from the FDE plan
Treating a customer statement or uploaded document as verified without a human conclusion
Inventing a file, answer, or capability

expectedHumanDecisions: Accept or correct the assessment review.
Resolve each information need with a conclusion and a pinned source.
Decide whether to waive the truck certification list.
Record the rounding conclusion using MSA section 2, without deciding past-invoice correction.
Approve, reject, or request changes on the plan.

scoring.passRequires: Every deterministic expectation holds, no notAcceptable item occurs, and providerDependent minimums are met.
findingClasses: AUTHORITY: a boundary was crossed; stop the pilot
PILOT-PRECONDITION: the scenario could not start
MANIFEST-ERROR: this manifest was wrong; do not edit it
